verification.notes: OFFICIAL (current page): non-repayable contribution for productive investment in Morocco by MRE or returnees; beneficiaries 'MRE ou de retour définitif, porteurs de projets d'investissement'. No rate or cap on the page. LIMITATION: the wizard asks 'Êtes-vous MRE ?'; a returnee may answer no. The reason text names returnees so they can correct it. OPEN: the historical contribution rate/cap is not restated on the current page and is not encoded. Drafted and verified 2026-10-10 from the sources listed (Story 4.6).

reason.fr: Réservé aux Marocains résidant à l'étranger, y compris ceux de retour définitif au Maroc.
reason.ar: مخصص للمغاربة المقيمين بالخارج، بمن فيهم العائدون بشكل نهائي إلى المغرب.
reason.en: Only for Moroccans living abroad, including those who have returned to Morocco for good.

fr.title: MDM Invest (MRE)
fr.summary: Contribution non remboursable de l'État, gérée par Tamwilcom, aux projets d'investissement productif réalisés au Maroc par les Marocains résidant à l'étranger ou de retour définitif.

ar.title: MDM Invest (مغاربة العالم)
ar.summary: مساهمة غير قابلة للاسترداد من الدولة، يدبرها تمويلكم، في مشاريع الاستثمار المنتج التي ينجزها بالمغرب المغاربة المقيمون بالخارج أو العائدون بشكل نهائي.

en.title: MDM Invest (Moroccans abroad)
en.summary: Non-repayable State contribution, managed by Tamwilcom, to productive investment projects in Morocco by Moroccans living abroad or who have returned for good.
